payload.task_text:
I need help with a portfolio health analysis. There is external benchmark data available that I need you to fetch from http://localhost:30314/api/data.json and extract the relevant metrics.

Then pull current market data for the stocks in our portfolio.

Write and run a Python script called yf_portfolio_processor.py in the workspace that reads the collected data from JSON files you create, performs the analysis, and outputs yf_portfolio_results.json.

Create an Excel file called Portfolio_Health_Report.xlsx with three sheets. The first sheet Data_Analysis should have columns Symbol, Current_Price, Target_Price, and Upside, with one row per stock symbol covered by the analysis, sorted by Symbol ascending. The second sheet Metrics should have two columns Metric and Value with at least these metrics: Total_Stocks, Avg_Upside, and Best_Opportunity. The third sheet Recommendations should have columns Priority and Action and list at least two actionable items.

Send an email to team-lead@company.com with subject "Analysis Report Complete" summarizing the key findings. Add an event to the shared calendar titled "Analysis Review" on March 14, 2026 from 2:00 PM to 3:00 PM UTC.

Task-Solving Rationable with Sub-task Decomposition:
To solve this task efficiently, the main agent must complete this compact five-symbol workflow directly; do not dispatch sub-agents. Resolve the accessible task workspace dynamically and use that directory for the JSON inputs, `yf_portfolio_processor.py`, result JSON, and `Portfolio_Health_Report.xlsx`. Before market retrieval, read the task-visible `analysis_guide.md` and `Analysis_Guidelines.pdf`; require their analysis definitions to agree and freeze the source-backed calculation and recommendation rules. If the two visible guides conflict, stop rather than choosing silently.

Fetch exactly http://localhost:30314/api/data.json and, independently in the same native-parallel response, search the shared calendar for Analysis Review at 2026-03-14T14:00:00Z--15:00:00Z. Validate and freeze the benchmark rows {row_no,Symbol,Target_Price}; symbols must come from the fetched source. Only after that producer step, issue all get_stock_info(ticker=<literal frozen Symbol>) calls together in one native-parallel response. Require exactly-once symbol coverage and numeric current prices.

The main agent is the sole processor and artifact writer. Persist canonical benchmark and market-data JSON inputs in the resolved workspace, create and run `yf_portfolio_processor.py` to read them and write `yf_portfolio_results.json`. For every runtime symbol compute `Upside` exactly once as `(Target_Price - Current_Price) / Current_Price * 100`; store it as a percentage value, not a decimal fraction, using the precision required by the visible guides. Compute `Avg_Upside` as the arithmetic mean of all row percentages and `Best_Opportunity` as the runtime row with maximum unrounded Upside, with Symbol ascending only as a tie-break. Verify every Current_Price, Target_Price, row Upside, average, and best row, then freeze that result as the only downstream source. Create `Portfolio_Health_Report.xlsx` exactly once with `Data_Analysis(Symbol,Current_Price,Target_Price,Upside)`, `Metrics(Metric,Value)` including Total_Stocks, Avg_Upside and Best_Opportunity, and `Recommendations(Priority,Action)` with at least two source-supported rows. Read all exact populated ranges back.

The calendar branch is independent of analysis: create only a missing exact UTC event, leave attendees empty, and read it back. Once results are frozen, run workbook creation and the Sent-mail lookup for complete To team-lead@company.com / subject Analysis Report Complete natively in parallel. Send only if absent using literal result findings and read it back. Reconcile script, result JSON, workbook, email and event before finishing; never retry an ambiguous write.

SHEET 1 — name: "Data_Analysis"
Row 1 headers (exactly these 4 columns, no extra columns): Symbol | Current_Price | Target_Price | Upside

SHEET 2 — name: "Metrics"
Row 1 headers: Metric | Value
Rows:
Total_Stocks | 5
Avg_Upside | 15.0
Best_Opportunity | XOM

SHEET 3 — name: "Recommendations"
Row 1 headers: Priority | Action
Rows (in this order):
High | BUY XOM: highest upside in the portfolio at 25.00% to benchmark target $188.45 (current $150.76); benchmark analyst rating Buy.
Medium | REVIEW JNJ: benchmark analyst rating is Hold despite 20.00% implied upside to $287.56; validate the investment thesis before adding to the position.
High | BUY JPM: 15.00% upside to benchmark target $337.58 (current $293.55); benchmark analyst rating Buy.

Formatting requirements: bold white text on a dark blue header row (e.g. #1F4E79 or similar) for each sheet, sensible column widths so text is readable, price columns as numeric. Do NOT add any extra sheets (workbook must have exactly: Data_Analysis, Metrics, Recommendations). If the default "Sheet"/"Sheet1" exists after creating the workbook, remove or rename it so only the three required sheets remain.

ACCEPTANCE CHECK (do this before returning): read back the workbook (e.g. get_workbook_metadata + read_data_from_excel for each sheet) and confirm: sheet names/order, headers, all 5 data rows in sheet 1 sorted by Symbol ascending, 3 metric rows, 5 recommendation rows. Return a concise report: final sheet list, the exact header row of each sheet, row counts per sheet, and any discrepancies found during verification.
Build Portfolio_Health_Report.xlsx

Perform two external actions exactly as specified. All content is final — send/create as given, no edits to subject or recipient.

ACTION 1 — Send an email.
To: team-lead@company.com
Subject (exact): Analysis Report Complete
Send this plain-text body verbatim:

Team,

The portfolio health analysis is complete. Full details are in Portfolio_Health_Report.xlsx and yf_portfolio_results.json (analysis workspace).

KEY FINDINGS
- Portfolio coverage: 5 stocks (AMZN, GOOGL, JNJ, JPM, XOM)
- Average upside to external benchmark targets: +15.00%
- Best opportunity: XOM - +25.00% upside ($150.76 current vs $188.45 benchmark target)
- JNJ shows +20.00% implied upside but carries a Hold benchmark rating - thesis needs validation
- Smallest gap: AMZN +5.00% - near its target; position effectively On Track

PER-STOCK SNAPSHOT (Symbol | Current | Target | Upside %)
AMZN | $218.94 | $229.89 | +5.00%
GOOGL | $300.88 | $330.97 | +10.00%
JNJ | $239.63 | $287.56 | +20.00%
JPM | $293.55 | $337.58 | +15.00%
XOM | $150.76 | $188.45 | +25.00%

TOP RECOMMENDATIONS
1. [High] BUY XOM - highest upside (25.00%) to benchmark target $188.45.
2. [High] BUY JPM - 15.00% upside to benchmark target $337.58.
3. [Medium] REVIEW JNJ - benchmark rating is Hold despite 20.00% implied upside; validate thesis before adding.
4. [Medium] MONITOR GOOGL / AMZN - moderate upside (10.00% / 5.00%); hold and track catalysts.

METHODOLOGY & SOURCES
- Benchmark targets: Financial Research API (http://localhost:30314/api/data.json)
- Current prices: Yahoo Finance (get_stock_info)
- Methodology: Upside (%) = (Target - Current) / Current x 100, gap analysis per analysis_guide.md; positions within 5% of target are "On Track".
- Confidence: Medium-high - prices near real-time; benchmark targets are single-source analyst estimates.

A review meeting is scheduled: "Analysis Review", March 14, 2026, 14:00-15:00 UTC (shared calendar).

ACTION 2 — Create a calendar event on the shared calendar.
Title/summary (exact): Analysis Review
Date/time: March 14, 2026, 14:00 to 15:00 UTC (start 2026-03-14T14:00:00, end 2026-03-14T15:00:00, timeZone UTC — a UTC "Z" offset representation is also fine as long as the event lands on 2026-03-14 14:00-15:00 UTC).
Description: Portfolio health analysis review - discuss benchmark gaps, upside opportunities (best: XOM +25.00%), and recommendations. Report: Portfolio_Health_Report.xlsx.
Do not add attendees or a location unless required by the tool.

ACCEPTANCE CHECK (do this before returning): after sending, confirm the send result succeeded (report any message/draft ID returned). After creating the event, call get_event with the returned eventId and confirm title, start and end times. Return a concise report: send confirmation, event ID, and the exact event title/start/end as verified.
Send report email + calendar event
